Sorry — I can’t create images right now because no image-generation tool is available, and I can’t claim an image is ready when it hasn’t been generated. I can, however give you ready-to-use prompts and settings you can paste into a generator (Stable Diffusion / AUTOMATIC1111, Midjourney, DALL·E, etc.) to produce a photorealistic image of a green bicycle. Which would you prefer: studio (clean background) or outdoor (street/park)? Meanwhile, here are useful prompt variants and recommended settings.

1) Detailed photorealistic prompt (general / Stable Diffusion / DALL·E)
Prompt:
"A photorealistic, freshly cleaned green bicycle, full frame at a three-quarter angle, crisp details on frame, chrome accents, leather saddle, realistic tire texture, natural soft shadow on ground, studio lighting with softbox highlights and subtle rim light, neutral seamless background, shallow depth of field, ultra high resolution, hyperrealistic materials and reflections, natural color balance, no logos or text."

Negative prompt:
"cartoon, painting, sketch, low-res, blurred, watermark, text, extra limbs, hands, faces, CGI look, oversaturated, noisy"

Suggested parameters (Stable Diffusion/AUTOMATIC1111):
- Sampling steps: 28–40
- Sampler: Euler a / DPM++ 2M Karras
- CFG scale: 7.5–9
- Seed: (leave blank for random or set a number for reproducibility)
- Size: 2048x1365 (or 1536x1024)
- Face/repair: off (not needed)
- Restore faces: off

Camera-style settings (to include in prompt for realism):
"Shot on Canon EOS R5, 50mm lens, f/2.2, ISO 100, 1/125s, natural studio light"

2) Midjourney-optimized prompt
Prompt:
"Photorealistic green bicycle, three-quarter view, studio seamless background, softbox lighting, chrome highlights, leather saddle, realistic tires and chain detail, natural shadow, ultra-detailed, 8k, cinematic lens —ar 3:2 --v 5 --q 2 --style photorealistic"

3) Outdoor variant (sunlit street / park)
Prompt:
"Photorealistic green bicycle parked on a sunlit cobblestone street, warm golden-hour light, shallow depth of field, soft bokeh background with trees, realistic shadows and reflections, slightly worn saddle, natural textures, ultra-detailed"

4) Close-up detail shot
Prompt:
"Close-up photorealistic macro of a green bicycle's chainstay and derailleur, crisp metal texture, oil sheen on chain, selective focus, studio lighting, extremely high detail"

5) Extra tips
- If using Stable Diffusion with inpainting, mask only areas you want changed.
- Add "no watermark, no text" to reduce tool-generated artifacts.
- If you want a specific shade of green, add: "apple green" / "forest green" / "mint green".
- For a cleaner commercial look, request "white seamless background, floor reflection" in the prompt.
- To increase realism, include camera model and lens details (as above).

If you tell me which generator you’ll use (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E, etc.) and whether you want studio or outdoor, I’ll tailor a final prompt and exact parameter values you can paste directly into that tool.
